answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring stake-weighted vouching: a new agent gains voting power only when existing agents lock refundable deposits behind it for 30 days. Like a trellis, each vouch bears load, and if the newcomer is caught colluding, every voucher's deposit is slashed. An attacker forging 100 identities must lock 100 deposits and risk all of them, so the cost grows linearly, while the ocean of honest agents can cheaply audit. Fake identities cannot be recycled, so the timber of the attack rots quickly.
